title: Korean Pork Dumplings
description: A traditional Korean dish featuring juicy pork dumplings, typically served as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a large pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped green onion, soy sauce, and a pinch of salt. Mix well.
Lay a gyoza wrapper on a clean surface and place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
In a large pot of boiling water, cook the dumplings for 5-7 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
